scenes.title: Two Baskets and a List
scenes.summary: After Henri restores kitchen power, Claire and Nadia grab woven baskets to shop at the Saturday neighbourhood market while Henri rewires Room 9.

scenes.title: Sweet Lemons and Golden Honey
scenes.summary: At the bustling Saturday market, Nadia teaches Claire how to choose fragrant lemons and honey when Thibault spots them and helps carry the heavy jars.

scenes.title: Twelve White Cups
scenes.summary: Antoine meets the group at the market pottery stall and helps Claire and Nadia choose thick white stoneware cups that keep tea hot.

scenes.title: Thursday Means Today?
scenes.summary: Back at the inn, Etienne proudly tells Henri about the bargain café chairs he ordered—then realises he said 'Saturday' instead of 'Thursday'.

scenes.title: A Mountain of Chairs
scenes.summary: Claire and Nadia return from the market to find Etienne trapped behind towers of unpainted folding chairs blocking the courtyard path.

scenes.title: Light in Room Nine
scenes.summary: Using the black tape from the market, Henri finishes the new copper wiring and switches on the warm glass ceiling lamp in Room 9.

scenes.title: Inside the Piano Lid
scenes.summary: Under the new ceiling lamp, Odette, Claire, and Antoine pull a folded sheet of handwritten piano music from behind the wooden music rest.

scenes.title: Ask My Aunt's Ledger
scenes.summary: Odette shows Etienne the unfinished handwritten waltz, and Etienne recognises his late aunt's handwriting—right as the city clerk leaves an urgent message.
